note: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA for the isolated demo engagement only. Shape matches POST /api/engagements/:eid/indicators (add evidence_ids when seeding).

indicators.title: Unexpected local administrator account
indicators.observation: SYNTHETIC: `net localgroup administrators` on ws01 lists svc_backup2, which is not in the demo account inventory.
indicators.why_suspicious: Unrecognized privileged accounts are a common persistence technique.
indicators.benign_explanations: Could be a service account created by IT for a new backup job.
indicators.additional_evidence_needed: Account creation event (4720) and the change ticket for backups.
indicators.analyst_assessment: Needs creation-time correlation before calling it malicious.

indicators.title: Listening port 4444 on ws01
indicators.observation: SYNTHETIC: `netstat -ano` shows LISTENING on 4444 owned by PID 3120.
indicators.why_suspicious: 4444 is a default port for common remote-access payloads.
indicators.benign_explanations: A developer test server could bind the same port.
indicators.additional_evidence_needed: Process image path and hash for PID 3120.
indicators.analyst_assessment: Suspicious until the owning process is identified.

indicators.title: Scheduled task running from a temp folder
indicators.observation: SYNTHETIC: `schtasks /query /v` lists task 'Updater' executing PowerShell from C:\Users\Public.
indicators.why_suspicious: Persistence via scheduled tasks from writable folders is common.
indicators.benign_explanations: Some vendor updaters use public folders.

indicators.title: Cleared Security event log
indicators.observation: SYNTHETIC: Event 1102 (audit log cleared) recorded on ws01.
indicators.why_suspicious: Log clearing can hide attacker activity.
indicators.benign_explanations: An administrator may have cleared logs during maintenance.
indicators.additional_evidence_needed: Who cleared it and whether a maintenance window existed.

indicators.title: Hosts file entry for update domain
indicators.observation: SYNTHETIC: hosts file redirects an update domain to an external address.
indicators.why_suspicious: Redirecting update traffic can enable malicious updates.
indicators.benign_explanations: A test override left by IT.
indicators.additional_evidence_needed: File modification time and change records.
indicators.analyst_assessment: Matches a documented demo test override.

indicators.title: Repeated SSH authentication failures from 198.51.100.77
indicators.observation: SYNTHETIC: four failed SSH logins in 18 seconds against web01.
indicators.additional_evidence_needed: Full auth log for the window and account lockout records.
